name: Kamikaze Kenshi Rosetta + Nobara no Hime
original_name: 神風剣士ロゼッタ+野薔薇の姫
source: This visual novel is a collection of works from [url=https://vndb.org/p9885]Ohimesama Club[/url] which includes the first digital novel of the popular "Kamikaze Kenshi Rosetta" and the short digital novel "Nobara no Hime".
translation: 这部视觉小说是[url=https://vndb.org/p9885]Ohimesama Club[/url]的作品合集，其中包括流行的《神风剑士罗塞塔》的第一部数字小说和短篇数字小说《野原之姬》。
